title: 第四章 冯斗第五章 动身
slug: 仙魂斗战第八百零四章闹事生非
lines: 老爷子听到了小豆子的话，连忙安慰他道：“小豆子，不要哭，这个世界谁都要死的，就要看到底是怎么样死而已。”
“我不要爷爷死，我不要，我不要！”
小豆子这时已经有点失控的状态，老爷子此时对于自己的身体比任何人都要清楚的，留给他的时间已经不多了，他连忙稳住小豆子的情绪，他连忙说：“小豆子，不要这样啊！爷爷有话要和你说的。”
好像老爷子这一番话马上就让小豆子静下来，他继续说：“小豆子，原本这一切要等待你成年之后，才告诉你的，但是我们现在已经没有那么多的时间啦！”
小豆子听到了老爷子的话，他马上整个人都已经懵了，他原本只有不到两岁的年龄，怎么可能接受得了这个呢？
老爷子此时已经管不了那么多，他继续说：“我并不是你的亲爷爷，我叫燕京，我当年是看到了你时，你在冰天雪地里！但是你的背后一段文字，是关于你身世的，可是我的能力有限，根本就没有办法看清楚你的一切。”
小豆子听到了老爷子的话，不由得内心一惊，他一直以来都认为自己是老爷子的亲孙子，但是现在非常之清楚，他根本就不是老爷子的孙子，但是他真正的身份是谁呢？
从今之后，小豆子可能因为这一点而开始寻找啦！
燕京轻轻地咽下一口气，他继续说：“我能够知道你的身世极少，你叫冯斗，你出生于一个与这里有莫大关系的地方，至于什么地方，我也不知道，不过你当时身上有一张药方让我直接突破了灵动九段，从这张配方来看就可以知道身后的家族绝非一般的。但是至于你为什么会到这里，我也不清楚……”
老爷子还没有说完，鲜血马上从他的口中吐出来，有点压不住鲜血不断地外流，冯斗此时连捂住燕京的嘴，他此时发觉自己已经抑制不住燕京的伤势。
燕京根据就已经无力回天啦！
燕京此时咽下最后一口气，他双眼硬睁着咽气的，因为他的内心有很多的不甘，他为了感谢对方，所以才拼尽全力为了报答对方的大恩大德啊！
他一直以来都想知道冯斗的身世，其实他也是有私心的，他希望可以从冯斗的家族得到提升自己的实力。
可是他慢慢地觉得自己已经喜欢上这个小子，然而他慢慢地打消这个想法，根本就是一心一意地帮助冯斗，不想到他居然越走越远啦！
随着燕京的离世，冯斗并没有流泪，反而他的内心更加是有自己的想法，他打开天灵盖之后，仿佛变了一个人，他此时对于自己的身世产生浓厚的兴趣。
他为了燕京建了一座简单的墓地，并且立了一块墓碑，上面写着“爷爷燕京之墓，孙冯斗亲书”。
现在的冯斗根本就不像是一个两岁多的小孩子，他突破成为灵修者，不但成为成为灵动等级，同时突破到灵动三段，他此时只不过还没有完全地掌握运用体内的灵力。
他处理好燕京的身后事之后，他整理好自己的行李，他发觉燕京能够给到留下来的，最重要的东西就是一个空间戒，同时他发觉自己能够控制一点点空间力量。
主要还是因为他打开空间戒时，他隐隐约约地察觉到一丝丝的空间波动，他也发觉他灵力海里有一个东西，也许因为他现在的能力太低，他发觉自己打开这个，他找了一个地方尝试打开。
可是他用了很多时间都没有打开，他觉得自己已经没有办法打开，就先留着，等待下一次机会，可是他并不知道他的生活就在这一刻，发生了天翻地覆的变化，只是一切都没有发觉而已。

The old man heard what Xiaodouzi said and quickly comforted him: "Xiaodouzi, don't cry. Everyone in this world is going to die. You just have to see how he dies."
"I don't want grandpa to die, I don't want it, I don't want it!"
Xiaodouzi was a little out of control at this time. The old man knew his body better than anyone else at this time, and there was not much time left for him. He quickly stabilized Xiaodouzi's mood, and said quickly: "Xiaodouzi, don't be like this! Grandpa has something to say to you."
It seemed that the old man's words immediately calmed down Xiaodouzi, and he continued: "Xiaodouzi, originally I had to wait until you grew up to tell you all this, but we don't have that much time now!"
When Xiaodouzi heard what the old man said, he was immediately stunned. He was only less than two years old, how could he accept this?
The old man couldn't control that much at this time. He continued: "I am not your biological grandfather. My name is Yan Jing. When I saw you, you were in the ice and snow! But there is a text behind you about your life experience. However, my ability is limited, and there is no way to see everything about you clearly."
When Xiaodouzi heard what the old man said, he couldn't help but feel shocked. He had always thought that he was the old man's grandson, but now it was very clear that he was not the old man's grandson at all, but who was his true identity?
From now on, Xiaodouzi may start looking for it because of this!
Yan Jing took a breath and continued: "I know very little about your life experience. Your name is Feng Dou. You were born in a place that has a lot to do with this place. As for where, I don't know, but you had a prescription on you at the time that allowed me to directly break through the ninth level of spirituality. From this formula, I can tell that the family behind you is by no means ordinary. But as for why you are here, I don't know..."
Before the old man finished speaking, blood immediately spat out from his mouth. He couldn't hold back the blood flowing out. Feng Dou covered Yan Jing's mouth. He realized that he could no longer suppress Yan Jing's injuries.
Yanjing is already helpless based on this!
Yan Jing took his last breath at this time. He died with his eyes open because he felt a lot of unwillingness in his heart. In order to thank the other party, he tried his best to repay the other party for his great kindness!
He has always wanted to know Feng Dou's life experience. In fact, he also has selfish motives. He hopes to improve his strength from Feng Dou's family.
But he slowly felt that he had fallen in love with this boy. However, he slowly gave up the idea and just devoted himself to helping Feng Dou. He didn't expect that he would go further and further away!
With the death of Yan Jing, Feng Dou did not shed tears. Instead, he had his own thoughts in his heart. After he opened the Tianling Cap, he seemed to be a different person. He was now very interested in his own life experience.
He built a simple cemetery for Yanjing and erected a tombstone with the words "Grandpa Yanjing's tomb, personally written by Sun Fengdou".
Feng Dou now does not look like a child over two years old at all. He has broken through to become a spiritual practitioner. Not only has he become a nimble person, but he has also broken through to the third level of agility. At this time, he has not yet fully mastered the use of the spiritual power in his body.
After he took care of Yanjing's death, he packed his luggage. He found that the most important thing Yanjing could give him was a space ring. At the same time, he found that he could control a little bit of space power.
Mainly because when he opened the space ring, he vaguely noticed a trace of space fluctuations. He also discovered that there was something in his spiritual sea. Perhaps because his current ability was too low, he found himself opening this. He found a place to try to open it.
But he spent a lot of time without opening it. He felt that he had no way to open it, so he kept it and waited for the next opportunity. But he didn't know that at this moment, his life had undergone earth-shaking changes, but he didn't notice anything.
